title: Head of Technology- Cash Revenue mgmt(Singapore, India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore and India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, Please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
  
  
The Head of Cash Revenue Management is a technical leadership role responsible for the supporting, post-execution, and value-added technology services surrounding the core transaction stream. Leading a team of engineers, this role will ensure that liquidity reporting, billing engines, and exception management operate with absolute accuracy, continuity, and compliance with industry schedules.
  
  

* Lifecycle Ecosystem Architecture: Own and evolve the technical platforms for payment investigations, exception management, fee/billing calculation engines, and intra-day liquidity reporting systems.
* Operational Resilience & Service Continuity: Ensure high availability and fault tolerance across supporting services. Guarantee post-processing workflows, liquidity feeds, and billing cycles meet regulatory cutoff deadlines and internal operational risk targets.
* Core Systems Integration: Oversee seamless technical integration between lifecycle services, core payment processing platforms, treasury operations, and ledger engines.
* People Leadership: Build and direct a cohesive, multi-disciplinary engineering organization across global delivery hubs.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Execute the Cash Revenue Management technology strategy in alignment with the broader Payments technology vision and roadmap established by the CIO Payments.
* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for investigations, exception management, billing, liquidity & deposit management, revenue management and liquidity reporting platforms.
* Drive modernization and simplification of legacy lifecycle management systems through adoption of modern engineering practices, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-enabled technologies.
* Establish strategic roadmaps for platform scalability, automation, data quality, observability and operational resilience.
* Partner with Payments Platform, Treasury Technology, Transaction Banking and Architecture teams to ensure supporting platforms evolve in line with the future-state Payment ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to enhance client servicing, operational efficiency and revenue realization through technology innovation.

**Business**

* Deliver and operate technology capabilities supporting investigations, payment exceptions, fee generation, billing, liquidity & deposit and revenue management services.
* Partner with Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Treasury, Operations and Product stakeholders to ensure lifecycle services support client needs and business growth objectives.
* Ensure billing and revenue engines accurately calculate, allocate and report revenues across products, clients and markets.
* Support commercialization of cash management capabilities through scalable billing, charging and reporting solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement of client servicing platforms supporting payment investigations, case management and operational transparency.
* Enable real-time liquidity visibility and intraday reporting capabilities required by internal stakeholders and external regulatory obligations.
* Provide technology leadership for strategic cash management and post-payment transformation initiatives.

**Processes**

* Lead end-to-end engineering, support and operational processes for all Cash Revenue Management platforms.
* Establish best-in-class software engineering, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering and operational support practices.
* Ensure investigation workflows, exception management processes, billing cycles and liquidity reporting services operate efficiently and within agreed service levels.
* Implement automation across reconciliation, exception handling, billing calculation, monitoring and reporting activities.
* Oversee integration between lifecycle platforms, payment processing engines, treasury systems, customer channels and finance systems.
* Drive continuous process optimization to reduce operational effort, improve data quality and enhance client experience.
* Manage platform dependencies, release governance, vendor relationships and service lifecycle activities.

**People & Talent**

* Build and lead a globally distributed engineering and technology organisation supporting investigations, liquidity management and revenue management platforms.
* Create a culture focused on engineering excellence, client centricity, ownership, operational discipline and innovation.
* Attract, develop and retain engineering talent across software development, platform engineering, SRE, data engineering and operational technology disciplines.
* Develop future leaders through structured succession planning, coaching and capability-building programmes.
* Foster strong collaboration across technology, operations, treasury, product and business teams.
* Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Establish clear objectives, performance metrics and accountability frameworks aligned to business outcomes.

**Risk Management**

* Own technology and operational risk management across the Cash Revenue Management technology estate.
* Ensure liquidity reporting, investigation workflows, billing services and exception management platforms comply with internal policies, regulatory obligations and operational risk requirements.
* Maintain effective controls ensuring integrity, completeness, timeliness and accuracy of financial and operational data.
* Lead management of technology, operational resilience, third-party, cyber security and change delivery risks within the domain.
* Ensure recovery capabilities, business continuity arrangements and disaster recovery plans meet agreed service objectives and regulatory expectations.
* Drive proactive monitoring, telemetry and incident prevention capabilities to minimize service disruptions.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit and Cyber Security functions to maintain a strong control environment.

**Governance**

* Establish governance frameworks ensuring lifecycle services operate within approved technology, risk and control standards.
* Provide regular reporting to the CIO Payments and governance forums covering service health, platform performance, operational risks, resilience metrics and transformation progress.
* Ensure platforms adhere to architecture standards, engineering policies, financial control requirements and regulatory obligations.
* Lead platform governance forums focused on operational stability, data quality, billing integrity, service performance and modernization initiatives.
* Maintain oversight of third-party vendors, managed service providers and strategic technology partners.
* Coordinate audit reviews, regulatory responses and remediation activities across the technology estate.
* Promote strong conduct, accountability and adherence to the Group's Values and Code of Conduct.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance and business conduct.
* Lead the organisation in achieving fair client outcomes through accurate billing, transparent investigations and reliable liquidity reporting.
* Promote a culture where risk, control and regulatory matters are proactively identified, escalated and resolved.
* Ensure supporting services operate in accordance with applicable financial crime, conduct, operational resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Foster an environment of integrity, transparency and accountability across all teams.

**Key stakeholders**

* Global Head of Transaction Banking
* Global Head of Cash Management / Cash Product Management
* Head of Payment Platform
* Global Head of Cash & Payment Operations
* Group Treasury / Liquidity Management
* Risk, Compliance & Cyber Security (ICS) Leadership
* Operations & Service Resilience Teams

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Payments Platform. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Payments Lifecycle Management
* SWIFT & Payment Network Ecosystem
* Billing & Revenue Management Platforms
* Liquidity & Cash Management Technology
* Platform Architecture & Distributed Systems
* Financial Services Regulatory Landscape
* Data & Reporting Platforms

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Strong engineering background in distributed software delivery and API frameworks.
* Strong understanding of client needs and tailoring services to accommodate.
* Expertise in post-payment processing domains: investigations, SWIFT Case Management, billing/revenue engines, and real-time liquidity reporting.
* Proven knowledge of operational risk management, recoverability frameworks, and strict industry clearing schedules.
* Demonstrated leadership managing multi-regional engineering and operational technology teams.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

title: Head of Payments Platform(Singapore, India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore and India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, Please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
  
  
Head of Payments Platforms will be the chief engineer and leader for Standard Chartered’s core payment engines. He/she will lead an engineering division of engineers responsible for building, modernising, and scaling high-availability, high-throughput payment execution engines across our global footprint, ensuring uninterrupted operations within strict regulatory resilience frameworks. This end-to-end responsibility includes core engines, direct debits, clearing gateways, adaptors, global routers, and integration services.
  
  

* Core Execution Architecture: Drive the technical vision, scale, and performance for core clearing engines, high-concurrency payment gateways, real-time transaction processing systems, and automated ledger entries.
* Corridor Scale & Latency: Engineer resilient, idempotent, low-latency execution engines capable of processing millions of cross-border and domestic payments daily across complex G-SIB corridors within critical cut off schedules and payment windows.
* Resilience, SRE & Telemetry: Guarantee maximum operational stability, near-zero downtime, and fault tolerance across execution pipelines. Own global transaction telemetry, and adherence to regulatory resilience standards (e.g., DORA, CPS 230) and strict RTO targets.
* Legacy Modernisation: Lead the architectural evolution from legacy transaction engines to modern, distributed engines without impacting live payment corridors.
* People Management: Direct, mentor, and scale an engineering organisation of engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Execute the Payments technology strategy defined by the CIO Payments and translate it into an actionable platform engineering roadmap.
* Define and continuously evolve the target-state architecture for core payment execution capabilities, including transaction processing, clearing, settlement, payment gateways and ledger platforms.
* Drive modernization of payment transaction engines, messaging layers, workflow orchestration and execution services while ensuring uninterrupted client and business operations.
* Lead engineering decisions that improve scalability, resilience, performance, security and maintainability of the Payments platform estate.
* Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Product stakeholders to ensure platform designs align with the broader Payments and enterprise technology strategy.
* Develop technology roadmaps for platform simplification, technical debt reduction, observability, automation and resilience improvements.
* Identify emerging technology opportunities and engineering innovations that support future payment volumes, new payment schemes and evolving client requirements.

**Business**

* Deliver and operate the strategic payment platform capabilities required to support the Bank's domestic, cross-border and real-time payments business.
* Partner with Transaction Banking, Cash Operations, Product, Architecture and Engineering teams to ensure platform capabilities support business growth and client outcomes.
* Own platform performance, transaction throughput, latency, availability and service quality across critical payment corridors.
* Support delivery of new payment products, market initiatives, regulatory changes and payment network requirements.
* Lead engineering execution for strategic payments programmes, market migrations and platform consolidation initiatives.
* Ensure platform capabilities support operational efficiency, straight-through-processing, resiliency and improved client experience.
* Provide technology leadership and subject matter expertise across payment execution, processing and settlement capabilities.

**Processes**

* Lead engineering, development, platform operations and service management processes across the Payments Platform estate.
* Establish engineering excellence standards covering software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering, testing, release management and platform operations.
* Ensure payment platforms are engineered for high throughput, low latency, idempotency and resilience across critical domestic and international payment corridors.
* Implement automated deployment, testing, monitoring, recovery and support processes to improve operational efficiency and reduce risk.
* Drive continuous improvement of payment execution, reconciliation, settlement and exception management processes.
* Lead management of platform dependencies, technology lifecycle activities and vendor-supported services.
* Support the Bank's product operating model through effective alignment of Build and Run teams across the platform lifecycle.

**People & Talent**

* Build and lead a high-performing global engineering, platform and site reliability organisation supporting the Payments Platform estate.
* Create a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, innovation, ownership and continuous improvement.
* Develop organisational capability across distributed systems engineering, cloud technologies, payments processing, resilience engineering and platform operations.
* Attract, retain and develop world-class engineering talent through effective succession planning, career development and capability-building initiatives.
* Coach and mentor engineering leaders and senior technical contributors.
* Establish clear performance expectations, engineering standards and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Promote agile ways of working, inclusion, collaboration and continuous learning across global teams.

**Risk Management**

* Own technology and operational risk management for the Payments Platform estate.
* Ensure payment platforms comply with regulatory resilience and operational risk requirements, including DORA, CPS 230 and applicable payment scheme obligations.
* Maintain strong controls around platform availability, recoverability, cyber resilience, secure development and technology lifecycle management.
* Lead identification, remediation and escalation of platform risks, vulnerabilities and control weaknesses.
* Ensure recovery strategies, disaster recovery capabilities and business continuity arrangements meet agreed recovery objectives.
* Drive proactive incident prevention through observability, telemetry, capacity management and resilience engineering practices.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cyber Security and Audit stakeholders to maintain an effective control environment across the platform estate.

**Governance**

* Operate governance frameworks that ensure the Payments Platform estate meets enterprise architecture, engineering, security and operational standards.
* Provide regular reporting on platform health, resilience, transformation progress, risks, technical debt and investment outcomes to the CIO Payments and governance forums.
* Ensure platform decisions comply with approved architecture standards, engineering controls, technology policies and regulatory requirements.
* Lead platform review forums covering resilience, service performance, operational risk, capacity management and modernization initiatives.
* Maintain effective oversight of third-party technology partners and platform service providers.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and remediation activities.
* Promote the Group's values, Code of Conduct and risk culture across the Payments Platform organisation.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Business Leaders (TB Cash and Payments)
* Country CIOs / CTOs, T&O Leadership
* Payments Product Management
* Engineering, Infrastructure & Platform Teams
* Enterprise Architecture
* Cyber Security / ICS
* Programme & Change Delivery Teams
* Operations & Service Resilience Teams

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Payments Platform. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Operational Risk Control
* Software Engineering
* Distributed Systems
* Transaction Banking Processes
* Payment Gateways
* Clearing Engine
* Message Transformation

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Deep expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and low-latency transaction processing in transaction banking.
* Mastery of high-throughput payment gateways, clearing engine design, message transformation, and ledger integration.
* Proven track record of maintaining high-availability SLAs, payment resilience, and regulatory operational risk controls within strict operational schedules.

**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

title: Python with java data pipelines/linux
description:
focused on building and maintaining data pipelines using Python and Java in a Linux environment. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data processing workflows that support business analytics and application needs. Daily responsibilities include writing clean, efficient code, integrating data from multiple sources, implementing error handling and monitoring, and ensuring data quality and performance. The team member will collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions, contribute to microservices-based architectures, and participate in code reviews and system design discussions. The role also includes maintaining documentation, following best practices for security and reliability, and supporting production deployments and troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**

* Strong programming skills with experience in Python and Java, including writing, testing, and maintaining production-ready code.
* Proficiency in software development concepts, including Software Development, Programming fundamentals, and use of Design Patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Jakarta EE or similar Java frameworks for building robust services and enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Microservices architectures, including designing, deploying, and integrating modular services.
* Comfort working in Linux environments, including scripting, process management, and basic system troubleshooting.
* Experience with data pipelines and ETL processes, including ingestion, transformation, and loading of structured and unstructured data.
* Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD practices, and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on performance and reliability.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in a structured, on-site environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
  
  

* The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence.
* The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation.
* Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. The role partners with Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business leaders to identify enterprise use cases, influence investment priorities, and scale innovation that delivers measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Define and own the GCFO Process Excellence and AI Strategy, establishing a clear vision for a future-state Finance platform that is integrated, scalable, resilient, data-driven, and AI-enabled.
* Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value.
* Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy.
* Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits.
* Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost.
* Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions.
* Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments.
* Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise.
* Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.

**Business**

* Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business.
* Ensure GCFO PE and AI materially improves decision-making quality, speed, and insight through predictive, prescriptive, and generative analytics.
* Support growth, product innovation, and balance-sheet optimisation, including emerging tokenised financial products.

* Define defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processes

* Build and lead a high-performing GCFO Process excellence organisation spanning platform ownership, product management, data, AI, engineering, and digital-asset expertise.
* Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.

**Risk Management**

* Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products.
* Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards.
* Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency.
* Embed audit readiness through disciplined governance, documentation, and testing.

**Governance**

* Establish control and review frameworks for GCFO platforms and processes, ensuring compliance with Group Control Governance and EUC policies.
* Define and update relevant policies, standards, and guidelines, and ensure platforms are benchmarked against industry best practice.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, and business conduct across GCFO.
* Resolve audit and regulatory issues with sustainable, long-term solutions.

**Key stakeholders**

* Group CFO and GCFO Leadership Team
* GCFO COO Management Team
* Group Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data Office
* Audit, Compliance, and Regulators

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Proven experience delivering large-scale finance transformation programmes in an international bank or equivalent regulated institution
